headline: Asian Stocks Fall as Technology Shares Track Wall Street Sell-Off
summary: Asian stock markets closed mostly lower, pressured by tech shares following a sell-off in Wall Street. Markets in South Korea and Taiwan hit three-month lows due to heavy chip exposure.
why: Broader regional tech indices often correlate heavily with US technology sector sentiment and semiconductor demand cycles.
why_moved: Regional equity indexes declined as weakness in US technology stocks spilled over into Asian chip-heavy markets.
